summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a 50% increase in its quarterly cash dividend to US$0.0225 per share, implying a US$0.09 annualized dividend, payable September 2, 2026, to shareholders of record August 19, 2026. The dividend increase reflects a board-approved capital return program, designated as an eligible dividend for Canadian tax purposes. No advisors or deal mechanics were specified. The filing is routine disclosure of a dividend declaration and policy amendment; watch for future dividend policy adjustments and the company's ability to sustain payments based on gold prices and financial performance.
